page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning storage must be attached externally. It also lacks integrated GPU accelerators, with a GPU count of zero. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count and balanced memory ratio, this instance offers high resource density for enterprise workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for large-scale deployments that require predictable compute power. Appropriate workloads include large-scale web serving, enterprise databases, container orchestration, and general-purpose business applications.
